body:
Credit to @mufanmu for the report — the sleep-window timeline (three DarkWakes, the 8-minute backoff, the missed day) is what moved this from the scheduler to the backoff counter. Fixed on `upstream/main`'s side of the ledger — a patch follows, attached here per the project's no-PR policy. ## Summary The daily loop keeps a count of check-ins in a row that never reached the vendor, and waits longer before each next try (a minute, doubled to half an hour — #265, for a machine that wakes before its network does). A DarkWake's failed check-in counted as one more *in that row* even when the last one had been hours before, so the row Macs sleep through midnight into — 03:40, 07:51, 09:38, each failing in its 2-7 s window — earned the full half-hour backoff by the time the lid opened. The look two minutes after waking for good was kept back by a failure from half an hour before, and on a day like 2026-11-03 the log shows nothing again until the day was over. Now a failure only continues the row while the last try's backoff was still running (its own retry on the dot included). A DarkWake hours later starts the row anew, so the first look after waking for good — or after a restart, the other way your 09:42 run lost the day — asks at once, with the minute-long wait #265 kept for a network still coming back. All five check-ins share the loop (WorkBuddy's plugin, WorkBuddy built-in, Trae CN, Qoder, MiniMax Code), so this covers the Qoder accounts your logs show timing out in the same DarkWakes too. The retry no longer fires inside a DarkWake itself — nothing in magpie knows a wake is a DarkWake — but the backoff no longer survives one, which is what kept your day from being made up. ## Verification | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | New test `TestWorkBuddyCheckinDarkWakeFailsNotStacked` (clock stepped, never slept) | RED before the fix (Tries stacked to 1 at 07:51), GREEN after | | Ablation: fix reverted, test kept | RED again | | #265's own retry schedule test `TestWorkBuddyCheckinOfflineRetriesSoon` (tried at 0, 1, 3, 7, 15, 31, 61, 91 min) | unchanged, GREEN | | Targeted: checkin/offline/plugin/qoder/minimax/trae suites | GREEN | | `go test -tags nogui ./internal/provider/` (full, ~109 s) | GREEN | | `go vet`, `gofmt`, `go build ./...` | clean | | Full package under `-race` | 3 fails, all reproduced on the untouched parent commit (`TestPluginCheckinAsksAgainAtUntil`, `TestSignInDoneOnceTheAccountIsBack`, `TestMoveToPlugin`; each GREEN alone) — pre-existing, not from this change | ## AI use Written by GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode); author ggbdpq.
Patch — SHA-256 first 16: 6a371e41b5724d06 The commit is on the branch below, one commit on top of `upstream/main` (667317159); `git am` it from there, or cherry-pick 3aef9965625781a6610b0b6cf53f045301d86d6c. The change in full, on the product side: ```diff --- a/internal/provider/checkin.go +++ b/internal/provider/checkin.go @@ -124,7 +124,11 @@ func (c checkiner) checkinNow(ctx context.Context, soon bool) []WorkBuddyCheckin // global proxy was refused there (#2777) r := a.do(ViaLogin(ctx, a.provider, a.User)) r.Day, r.At = day, now - if r.Offline && seen && prev.Day == day && prev.Offline { + // tries in a row are only so while the last try's backoff was + // still running, its own retry on the dot included: a DarkWake's + // failure hours later (#5020) is the day's first again, and the + // look on waking for good asks at once + if r.Offline && seen && prev.Day == day && prev.Offline && now.Sub(prev.At) <= prev.retryAfter() { r.Tries = prev.Tries + 1 } ``` plus `TestWorkBuddyCheckinDarkWakeFailsNotStacked` in internal/provider/workbuddy_checkin_test.go (the 03:40 / 07:51 / 09:38 DarkWake timeline, stepped clock).
Branch: https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/fix/5020-checkin-catchup (head 3aef9965625781a6610b0b6cf53f045301d86d6c) Attribution: patch by ggbdpq, written by AI (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode) — happy to test a build if useful; the failing-and-fixed behavior is covered by the stepped-clock test, no real sleep needed.
